HF17
Fixes launcher crashes after successful per-game install/update by making cache parsing and post-install UI refresh fail-open.
Legacy/malformed library entry shapes are normalized safely instead of throwing on missing Exe properties.
Fallout4.exe uses a title-scoped D3D11 safe route: 120 native Presents before preprocessing, D3D11 neural interop disabled, conservative current-frame ELYSIUM.
Control Deck now starts only on HOME and self-falls back to a visible desktop Deck if in-frame handshake fails.
HF16 recovery, HF15 launcher/library changes, Motion Guard/Ghosting Guard, PCSX2 and REVENANT are preserved.
